info.title: InfraPulse Backend MVP
info.description: InfraPulse Backend v2 local implementation through B16. Existing Collector/device, source, Asset, topology, log, SIP, command, rollback, PKI, monitoring and authentication contracts are retained. B12 provides durable multisource incident correlation with evidence/timeline, guarded hardware/log/audit/configuration/topology producers and source-scoped Prometheus/Alertmanager recovery. B13 adds reviewed anonymized multisource AI context, consent, durable jobs, validated references and history; model calls cannot execute remediation. B14 adds Asset/site unified reports, distinct recurring episodes, immutable snapshots and administrator-authorized daily/weekly UTC schedules. B15 supplies a PostgreSQL MetricStore baseline without requiring TSDB or Grafana. B16 verifies RBAC, failure/replay/restart behavior and compatible Collector fixtures, adds safe operational error logging and rejects unknown newer schema versions. Real team Zabbix/Prometheus servers, vendor hardware, Linux Ansible execution and live LLM acceptance remain separate required stand checks; local fixtures are not production acceptance. Active-active gRPC session ownership and automatic HA failover are not implemented.

expression.description: Admin configured PromQL, parsed and narrowed at EVERY vector selector with target identity labels. No raw viewer expressions.

identity_labels.description: Must contain job and instance; include cluster/namespace where identity would otherwise collide.

alerts_enabled.description: Opt in to firing alerts for selected targets. Missing alerts are not inferred as recovery.

PhysicalLocationInput.description: site has no parent; building->site, room->building, rack->room. Kind and parent are immutable. Rack capacity 1..100. Create expected_revision=0, update requires current revision. Duplicate sibling names rejected.

AssetPlacement.description: Path ordered site->building->room->rack. Unit numbering increases from 1; rack positions occupy [start_unit,start_unit+height_units-1]. No front/rear overbooking. Outside rack requires room. Unplaced has zero units and null location. Placement revision is independent from inventory refreshes.

PlacementRequest.description: asset_id may be omitted; if supplied must match path. expected_revision=0 for first placement, otherwise current placement revision. Changing to unplaced explicitly frees all slots.

PlacementImport.description: Atomic reviewed JSON import, maximum 64 KiB. Existing location IDs required. Supports rack swaps; entire batch rolls back on one conflict.

InventoryClaim.description: Current source-owned claim. observed_at uses explicit fact/evidence observation time if supplied; snapshot_observed_at is last accepted snapshot time, fact_received_at is receipt of fact version, not every heartbeat. Source enabled/clock quality do not claim live freshness.

InventoryAttribute.description: Scalar chooses highest confidence only if best claims agree; canonical source breaks ties between equal values. All differing usable claims remain visible. Rejected identities never selected. IPs are sorted union; components/networks/hardware remain source-scoped with no guessed component merge. Unknown value/selected=null. Management interfaces remain scoped to each binding and include only selected normalized Zabbix interface fields.

ResolvedInventory.description: Current inventory, not hardware online state. Complete means vendor/model/serial available; all other fields optional. Source_location is a raw claim, never an applied placement. Bounded at 128 bindings and 8 MiB snapshots. Old per-binding /inventory stays unchanged.

GlobalTopologyNode.description: An existing active Asset or a source-scoped placeholder. No guessed online/power/health. Unknown neighbors never create Assets.

neighbor.description: Canonical Neighbor proto JSON; raw bytes base64 and typed observation time retained.

GlobalTopologyEdge.description: Canonical undirected evidence group; each evidence retains directed from/to. Bidirectional requires active resolved reciprocal advertised typed ports. Does not prove physical cable. Port changes retain old evidence until TTL. Protocol-local port IDs are not guessed equivalent.

GlobalManagementRelation.description: Separate management relation, not a network cable. Resource resolution includes Collector source, simulation scope and BMC target/type/protocol/instance.

GlobalTopologyGraph.description: Additive global topology above existing Asset mappings. No asset merge from LLDP/hostname. Complete inventory required for unique remote resolution. Bounded 4000 bindings/16 MiB inventory, 10000 observations/16 MiB, 2000 management groups. Edge pagination applies after grouping, and total_edges counts loaded evidence only.

GlobalTopologyChange.description: Discovery/TTL lifecycle history. Immutable version evidence; current_local_asset_id follows current binding and is not an historical Asset mapping. asset_id filter selects current local reporter only. Earlier full snapshots remain in legacy archive. BMC changes are inventory fact history; merge/split decisions have separate audit.

freshness_max_age_seconds.description: Effective per-item freshness window. Applied managed cadence may extend the automatic 300s fallback; explicit max_age_seconds always takes precedence.

AssetHardwareItem.description: Source-specific observation; related entries preserve the owning Asset ID and verified management relation IDs. Power Off is independent from hardware health. Freshness is evaluated at read time against max_age_seconds, source availability, simulation session and clock quality.

completeness.description: Transport does not prove that all audit lines were collected. Counts describe the selected records only.

AssetVoIPInput.description: Admin reviewed association. Collector source and inventory source may differ for real observations. Simulated targets require the same Collector and exact session. Address/transport/source must match a received scoped observation. Changes require current revisions, reason, confirmation and Idempotency-Key.
